title: Fourteen Springs and One Short Line
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：emphasis　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 emphasis 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 my teacher ① put an emphasis that no student in the room would have repeated, and he said the putting was the whole of the spring. The ② emphasis, meaning the stress and not the accent, ran fourteen springs and stayed unnamed in the book; an emphasis, he said, is the only thing in a room that is judged by how long it is left unrepeated.

Every ③ emphasis in that room had the same short line at the end of it, and the ④ emphasis at the end, meaning the one they kept for the weakest pupils and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An emphasis, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to repeat; my teacher said the repeating is the part that fills fourteen springs.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the emphasis was the whole of the story, meaning the accent and not the stress. The ⑥ emphasis, meaning the accent and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody hears and nobody writes down; emphasis, he said, is either something you put or the only word that means both a stress and an accent. He said the accent is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ emphasis had become a line in an outline, and the outline had become an argument about the short line. The ⑧ emphasis of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in April, was one room and fourteen springs of repeating; emphasis, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to repeat. She said the repeating was never mentioned.

The ⑨ emphasis I remember is the one named in the outline, which faded in 1985 and is still described as the quietest in the room. An ⑩ emphasis, my mother said in 1987, is the only one that improves by being repeated; every emphasis, she said, is an accent that has agreed to look like a stress. She said the accent was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 强调；重点（指那间教室里强调过的那一点）
B. n. 强调；重点（指那份强调本身，与重音相对）
C. 固定搭配：put an emphasis 把重点放在
D. n. 强调；重点（指留给最弱的学生们的那一点）
E. n. 强调；重点（抽象总称，指一间教室的着重之事）
F. n. 强调；重点（指提纲上写到、被列名的那一点）
G. n. 重音；强调语气（指故事里人人都听出却无人写下的那样东西）
H. n. 重音（抽象总称，指人人都听出却无人写下的那种语气）

items.q: put an emphasis that no student in the room would have repeated
The emphasis, meaning the stress and not the accent
the emphasis was the whole of the story
the emphasis had become a line in an outline
The emphasis of the whole thing
An emphasis, my mother said in 1987

answers.why: put an emphasis 意为“把重点放在”，1964 年老师把重点放在了一点上，教室里没有一个学生肯复述它。
emphasis 意为“强调、重点”，指那份强调本身而不是重音，它经过了十四个春天而在簿子上没有名字。
emphasis 意为“强调、重点”，指那间教室里的每一处强调，每一处后头都有同一行短短的记号。
emphasis 意为“强调、重点”，指留给最弱的学生们的那一点，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
emphasis 意为“重音、强调语气”，指故事里人人都听出却无人写下的那样东西，叔叔说这个重音就是那个故事的全部。
emphasis 意为“重音”，指人人都听出却无人写下的那种语气而不是那份强调，是故事里人人都听出、却无人写下的东西。
emphasis 意为“强调、重点”，指提纲上写到、被列名的那一点，到 1973 年这点强调成了提纲里的一行。
emphasis 意为“强调、重点”，老师四月写道，整件事的着重之事是一间教室和十四个春天的复述。
emphasis 意为“强调、重点”，我记得的是提纲上列名的那一点，1985 年淡去了，至今仍被说成教室里最安静的一点。
emphasis 为抽象总称，母亲 1987 年说，一处强调是唯一会因为被好好复述而变得更好的东西。
